ShortDescription.Value: Reset traffic, set jam thresholds, and stop accidents. Turn off Reset Traffic, Jam Threshold, and Accidents Be Gone.

LongDescription.Value:
One Options page for a traffic reset, jam despawn thresholds, and accidents held at zero. Version 0.0.1 alpha.
Turn off [Reset Traffic](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/159366/Windows), [Jam Threshold](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/160084/Windows), and [Accidents Be Gone](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/160339/Windows) before you load a city. Those mods are no longer supported. Leaving one on runs that system twice.
Jam Threshold and Accidents Be Gone stay off until you enable them on their tabs.
## Features
* **Reset Traffic** clears the vehicle and pedestrian types you check, so demand can spawn fresh traffic. * **Jam Threshold** sets how long a stuck jam lasts before those vehicles despawn, instead of the vanilla stuck-mover check. * **Accidents Be Gone** holds the traffic-accident chance at zero, and can clear wrecks already on the roads.
## How to use
* ESC, Options, Traffic Utils. Open the tab you want. * The first time you launch, if Mods_TrafficUtils.coc is missing, settings are copied once from the three older files. Those files stay where they are.
